strings.ix.title: Restaurants und Cafés
strings.ix.heroSum: Ihr Wegweiser zum Essen in Al-Ahsa: ausgewählte Restaurants, Cafés und Bäckereien für „rotes Brot“ in Hofuf, Al-Mubarraz und der Umgebung – von Kulturerbe-Ambiente und traditioneller Hausmannskost bis zu modernen Lokalen und Spezialitätenkaffee – jeweils mit Foto und Standort in Google Maps, einen Klick entfernt. Die Liste wächst stetig weiter.
strings.ix.bakeriesNote: Dattelbrot und rotes Brot sind ein und dasselbe – zwei Namen für ein Gericht. Hier wird dafür der Tanur (Lehmofen) angefeuert.
strings.ix.newWindow: (öffnet Google Maps in einem neuen Fenster)
strings.ix.hoursNote: Die Öffnungszeiten stammen von Google Maps und können sich ändern – prüfen Sie den Link zu diesem Ort.
strings.ix.emptyMsg: Keine Treffer – erweitern Sie die Suche oder wählen Sie „Alle Gebiete“.
strings.ix.srcNote: Bewertungen und Öffnungszeiten von Google Maps – zuletzt aktualisiert {date}

termbase_additions.source: Duden-Wortbildung aus 'der Kaffee' + 'die Spezialität'; etabliertes Fachwort der deutschen Kaffeebranche (vgl. Verband Deutscher Spezialitäten-Kaffee e.V., SCA Deutschland). Keine Web-Verifikation in dieser Umgebung möglich; Genus unstrittig, da vom Grundwort 'der Kaffee' bestimmt.

notes: heroSum: en 'traditional food' vs ar 'الأكل الشعبي' (folk/home-style food) - kept close to en ('traditionelle Gerichte'); not reconciled per instructions, flagged for stage 2+.

heroSum: en 'modern spots' vs ar 'المطاعم العصرية' (modern restaurants) - translated 'moderne Lokale' (avoids repeating 'Restaurants' three times in one sentence and avoids Denglisch 'Spots'); fact preserved (modern eating places).

ix.districtLabel/ix.districtAll: chose 'Gebiet'/'Alle Gebiete' rather than reusing det.area='Lage' verbatim - 'Lage' pluralizes awkwardly ('Lagen') for a multi-option dropdown of districts/streets/cities; 'Gebiet' stays a neutral non-administrative term (avoids 'Bezirk') and pluralizes naturally. ix.searchPh echoes the same concept ('Gebiet').

Tanur gloss placement: per gloss_regel the gloss belongs at first running-text occurrence, not a heading/eyebrow - ix.bakeriesEyebrow stays 'Tanur' unglossed, gloss placed in ix.bakeriesNote as the compound 'Tanur-Öfen (Lehmöfen)' since the termbase entry only covers the singular 'der Tanur (Lehmofen)' and this context needs the plural 'ovens' across several bakeries.

'rotes Brot' is quoted in „...“ at its first running-text occurrence on the page (ix.heroSum), matching the published /de/food/ dish-card convention; left unquoted afterwards in ix.bakeriesH. 'Dattelbrot' appears in ix.bakeriesNote, satisfying the C5b pairing guard on this page.
Added termbase entry for 'Spezialitätenkaffee' (specialty coffee) - no prior termbase entry existed; generic compound noun, gender unambiguous from the head noun 'der Kaffee'.
ix.title = 'Restaurants und Cafés' matches the published nav.dine string verbatim (it serves as H1, breadcrumb label, tab title and ItemList name per pack.json context).

STAGE 2 (editor) — closed translator's open question on heroSum: en 'traditional food' vs ar 'الأكل الشعبي' (folk/home-style, not merely 'traditional'). Replaced 'traditionellen Gerichten' with 'traditioneller Hausmannskost' - a native, idiomatic German noun that carries exactly the home-style/folk connotation ar adds, while 'traditioneller' keeps en's explicit word too. No fact added or dropped, just a more precise register match.

STAGE 2 — fixed a pleonasm in ix.bakeriesNote: stage 1's 'Tanur-Öfen (Lehmöfen)' literally says 'oven-ovens', since the termbase already defines 'der Tanur' as the clay oven itself ('der Tanur (Lehmofen)'), not a qualifier needing '-Öfen' appended (same class of error the termbase explicitly bans for 'Souk-Markt'/'Jabal-al-Qarah-Berg'). Rewrote as two shorter sentences using the termbase form directly ('der Tanur (Lehmofen)', singular, generic/collective use - standard German for referring to a piece of equipment/method across a group of places) and dropped the invented, unsourced German plural inflection of the loanword 'Tanur'. C5b pairing (Dattelbrot + rotes Brot in the same string) is preserved; the Tanur gloss still appears exactly once on the page, at this first running-text occurrence.

STAGE 2 — ix.hoursNote: 'den Link des Ortes' was a calque of the English possessive ('the place's link'); replaced with the more natural German 'den Link zu diesem Ort'. Same referent (the card's Google Maps link), Sie-form kept.

STAGE 2 — ix.heroSum: removed the stacked '–,' (closing em dash immediately followed by a comma) before 'jeweils mit Foto…'; a closing Halbgeviertstrich already provides the separation, so the extra comma was redundant/non-standard. Compare the published /de/stay/ heroSum, which uses a single dash into the trailing 'jeweils mit Foto und Standort in Google Maps' appositive without doubling the punctuation.

STAGE 2 — verified against verify-stage.mjs's de-din guard block: all four locked Google Maps strings (ix.newWindow, ix.ratingLabel, ix.closedPerm, ix.closedTemp) left byte-for-byte unchanged; ix.srcNote tail, ix.moreLabel (no arrow), ix.searchPh (ends in …), ix.emptyMsg (quotes ix.districtAll verbatim in „…“), and the Dattelbrot/rotes Brot pairing in ix.bakeriesNote all re-checked and intact after edits.

STAGE 2 — no Satzklammer, Denglisch, exclamation-mark, or superlative-stacking issues found elsewhere in the 32 strings; register, case endings after termbase names (Al-Ahsa, Hofuf, Google Maps, Tanur) and Sie-form usage all confirmed correct on review.
